{{Orphan|date=April 2020}}

'''Evgenii Evgenevich Nikitin''' ({{Langx|ru|Евгений Евгеньевич Никитин}}, {{Langx|de|Jewgeni Jewgenjewitsch Nikitin}}; born 9 May 1933 in [[Saratov]], Russia) is a Russian theoretical chemist and emeritus professor at the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology|Technion]] in [[Haifa]], Israel.

== Education ==
Nikitin studied physics at [[Saratov State University]] from 1950 to 1955. Later he moved to the Institute for Chemical Physics at [[Russian Academy of Sciences|The Academy of Sciences of the USSR]]  [[Moscow]] where he earned his doctorate in 1965. From 1965 to 1991 he was Professor at the Institute for Chemical Physics and the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]]. In 1992 he went to the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology, where he became [[Emeritus]] professor in 2002. Since 2002 he has been guest professor at the [[Max Planck Institute for Biophysical Chemistry]] in [[Göttingen]].

His field of work is the theoretical description of [[Elementary reaction]]s with [[quantum mechanics|quantum theoretical]] methods, especially by using different quantum mechanical approximations. He is particularly well known for his investigations of [[Adiabatic process|non-adiabatic]] electronic effects in dynamic and kinetic chemical reactions, in other words, effects that cannot be described in the [[Born–Oppenheimer approximation]]. Nikitin has published more than 300 scientific works in journals as well as several specialist books, some of which have only been published in Russian.

He has received many awards and honors. In 1977 he became a member of the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina|Leopoldina]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/en/members/list-of-members/list-of-members/member/Member/show/evgueni-e-nikitin/|title=List of Members|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=en|access-date=2020-01-12}}</ref> Since 2012 he has been a corresponding member of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adw-goe.de/mitglieder/personendetails/person/evgeny-e-nikitin/|title=Prof. Dr. Evgeny E. Nikitin|website=adw-goe.de|access-date=2020-01-12}}</ref> In 1987 he became a member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.iaqms.org/members/nikitin.php|title=International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science|website=www.iaqms.org|access-date=2020-01-12}}</ref>
